operatingSystems.setup: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps less nano unzip xz-utils python3 python3-venv build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps less nano unzip xz-utils python3 python3-venv build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
dnf install -y --allowerasing ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps-ng less nano unzip xz tar gzip which findutils python3 gcc gcc-c++ make && dnf clean all

pacman-key --init && pacman-key --populate archlinux manjaro && pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed ca-certificates curl git sudo bash procps-ng less nano unzip xz tar gzip which python base-devel && pacman -Scc --noconfirm

commonSetup: arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; esac; tarball=$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | awk '{print $2}' | grep -E "^node-v[0-9.]+-linux-$arch\.tar\.xz$"); curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$tarball" | tar -xJ -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --exclude=CHANGELOG.md --exclude=LICENSE --exclude=README.md && node --version && npm --version
